title: Till There Was You, after Rod Stewart

details.title: Till There Was You
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, written out by hand from his voice, a note for each word he sings, without his slides and scoops. An octave above where he sings it, in his key: concert D♯4 to F♯5 (written F4 to G♯5).
facts: Till There Was You, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, written out by hand, bar by bar
E concert, F♯ for the trumpet
Pickup, A, A, bridge, A, bridge, A. The band's chorus in the middle is left out.
